objective_pt: Fazer o check-in com uma reserva, perguntar sobre café da manhã, Wi-Fi e horário de saída, e reclamar de um problema simples no quarto.

teacher.goal_pt: Abrir o tema com experiências em hotéis e a frase de chegada na recepção.
prompts: Do you like staying in hotels?
What's important for you in a hotel?
watchFor: "I have a reserve" (do "tenho uma reserva"); o certo é "reservation" ou "booking".
"Breakfast is included?" sem inverter a pergunta.

exercises.prompt: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Silva.
accepted: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Silva
Hi, I have a reservation in the name of Silva
Hello, I have a reservation under the name Silva

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Reserva" de hotel é "reservation" ou "booking". "Reserve" é verbo (reservar).
commonErrors.correction_en: I have a reservation under the name Silva.

exercises.instruction_pt: Você quer um quarto para você e seu marido, com uma cama de casal. Qual você pede?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Double room" tem cama de casal. "Single" é para uma pessoa, e "couple room" não se usa.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu tenho uma reserva para três noites."
accepted: I have a reservation for three nights
I've got a reservation for three nights
I have a booking for three nights
I've got a booking for three nights
I booked a room for three nights
I have a reservation for 3 nights
I made a reservation for three nights

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O substantivo é "reservation" (ou "booking"). "Reserve" é o verbo.
commonErrors.correction_en: I have a reservation for three nights.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Duração da reserva vai com "for": "for three nights".
commonErrors.correction_en: I have a reservation for three nights.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender as palavras do hotel: front desk, key card, included, check out, towel, wake-up call.
prompts: Is breakfast usually included in hotels in Brazil?
What time do you usually check out?
Do you ask for extra towels?
watchFor: "Reception" está certo, mas nos EUA é mais comum "front desk".
"The breakfast is incluse?"; a palavra é "included".

exercises.example_en: If you need anything, call the front desk.
Breakfast is included in the price.

exercises.meaning_pt: fazer o check-out, sair do hotel
exercises.example_en: We need to check out before eleven.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ligue cada palavra ao seu significado.
Diga em inglês: "O café da manhã está incluído?"
accepted: Is breakfast included?
Is the breakfast included?
Is breakfast included in the price?
Does the price include breakfast?
Does it include breakfast?
Is breakfast included in the room rate?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta com "to be", o "is" vem primeiro: "Is breakfast included?".
"Café da manhã" é uma palavra só: "breakfast".

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar as palavras "suite" ("suit": suíte), "towel" ("TAU-ol") e o "-ed" de "included" (sílaba a mais).
watchFor: "Suite" pronunciado "su-í-te"; em inglês é "suít", igual a "sweet".
"Hotel" com a força no começo; em inglês é "ho-TEL".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "Included" termina em "d", então o "-ed" vira sílaba: "in-CLU-did".
exercises.prompt: Is breakfast included? And is there free Wi-Fi?
accepted: Is breakfast included? And is there free Wi-Fi?
Is breakfast included? Is there free Wi-Fi?

exercises.prompt: Could I have two more towels, please?
accepted: Could I have two more towels, please?
Can I have two more towels, please?

exercises.instruction_pt: Onde fica a força em "hotel" em inglês?
exercises.explanation_pt: "Hotel" tem a força no fim, como em português: "ho-TEL". O "h" é um sopro suave.

teacher.goal_pt: Entender as informações da recepção e responder às perguntas do check-in.
prompts: Can I see your passport, please?
How many nights are you staying?
watchFor: Não entender os números do quarto ditos separados: "four oh two" = 402.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a recepcionista e escolha a informação certa.
exercises.listen: Your room is four oh two, on the fourth floor. Breakfast is from seven to ten, and check-out is at eleven.
options: Quarto 402, 4º andar; café das 7 às 10; check-out às 11.
Quarto 420, 2º andar; café das 7 às 11; check-out às 10.
Quarto 402, 4º andar; café das 8 às 10; check-out às 12.
exercises.explanation_pt: "Four oh two" é 402 ("oh" é o zero). "Fourth floor" é o 4º andar.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda que você vai ficar duas noites.
exercises.listen: How many nights are you staying with us?
accepted: Two nights
2 nights
For two nights
I'm staying for two nights
I'm staying two nights
I am staying for two nights
We're staying for two nights
Just two nights
Two nights, please

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que o ar-condicionado não está funcionando.
exercises.listen: Front desk, how can I help you?
accepted: The air conditioning isn't working
The air conditioning is not working
The air conditioning doesn't work
The air conditioner isn't working
The air conditioner doesn't work
The AC isn't working
The AC doesn't work
Hi, the air conditioning in my room isn't working
Hello, the air conditioning isn't working
The air conditioning in my room doesn't work
There's a problem with the air conditioning. It isn't working

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para aparelho, "funcionar" no dia a dia é "work": "It isn't working".
O aparelho é "air conditioning" ou "air conditioner". "Air-conditioned" é um adjetivo (climatizado).
A negação é "isn't working" ou "doesn't work".

teacher.goal_pt: Fazer o check-in completo e resolver um pedido ou um problema na recepção.
prompts: Good evening, welcome to the Grand Hotel. Do you have a reservation?
Could you fill in this form, please?
Is there anything else I can help you with?
watchFor: "What time is the check-out?" está certo, mas "What time is check-out?" é mais natural.
"Can you wake me up at seven?" está ok; "Could I have a wake-up call at seven?" é o padrão de hotel.
"Is possible to...?" sem o "it": "Is it possible to...?".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "A que horas é o check-out?"
accepted: What time is check-out?
What time is the check-out?
When is check-out?
What time do we have to check out?
What time do I have to check out?
What time do I need to check out?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta, o "is" vem antes: "What time is check-out?".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "É possível deixar as malas aqui depois do check-out?"
accepted: Is it possible to leave our bags here after check-out?
Is it possible to leave my bags here after check-out?
Is it possible to leave the bags here after check-out?
Can I leave my bags here after check-out?
Can we leave our bags here after check-out?
Could I leave my luggage here after check-out?
Can I leave my luggage here after I check out?
Is it possible to leave our luggage here after check-out?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês a frase precisa do sujeito "it": "Is it possible to...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Is it possible to leave our bags here after check-out?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Luggage" não tem plural. Diga "my luggage" ou "my bags".
commonErrors.correction_en: Can I leave my luggage here after check-out?
Can I leave my bags here after check-out?

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa para formar a pergunta.
accepted: Could I have a wake up call at seven

exercises.instruction_pt: Você chega ao hotel. Faça o check-in e tire duas dúvidas com a recepcionista.
exercises.prompt_en: Good evening and welcome to the Ocean View Hotel! Do you have a reservation with us? And how can I help you?
guidelines_pt: Diga que tem reserva e em nome de quem: "Yes, I have a reservation under the name...".
Diga quantas noites vai ficar: "for... nights".
Faça 2 perguntas: café da manhã, Wi-Fi, horário do check-out ou onde fica o elevador.

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar as perguntas de hotel e o vocabulário de quarto.
prompts: What do you ask when you arrive at a hotel?
What do you say if something in the room is broken?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Tem Wi-Fi no quarto?"
accepted: Is there Wi-Fi in the room?
Is there Wi-Fi in the rooms?
Does the room have Wi-Fi?
Is there free Wi-Fi in the room?
Do you have Wi-Fi in the rooms?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Tem...?" (existe) é "Is there...?". Ou use "Does the room have...?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Is there Wi-Fi in the room?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para perguntar, comece com "Does": "Does the room have Wi-Fi?".

exercises.sentence: Your room is ___ the third floor.
accepted: on

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Andar de prédio vai com "on": "on the third floor".
commonErrors.correction_en: Your room is on the third floor.

exercises.instruction_pt: O que é um "wake-up call" no hotel?
exercises.explanation_pt: A recepção liga para o quarto no horário pedido para te acordar.

exercises.prompt: Thank you. Have a nice evening!
accepted: Thank you. Have a nice evening
Thanks. Have a nice evening
Thank you. Have a good evening
